༄༅/ /chos spyod kyi rim pa thar lam rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥshrī gu ru we sarba budha bo dhi sa twa bh+yeḥrab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos spyod kyi rim pa thar lam rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na maḥshrī gu ru we sarba budha bo dhi sa twa bh+yeḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gzugs kun/ /gcig bsdus rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma 'byung*/ /dbyer med chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling*/ /byang chub bar du gtsug gi rgyan du mchod/ /bden gnyis rtsa brtan tshogs gnyis sdong po rgyas/ /don gnyis 'dab stong phan bde'i 'bras bu can/ /dge ba'i ljon shing ston mchog zas gtsang sras/ /chos dang dge 'dun bcas la phyag bgyi'o/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gshegs shul snyegs bya'i phyir/ dang po'i las can skal bar ldan pa dag /dang po nyid nas chos spyod sgrub pa la/ /brtson gang rnam kun don yod kho na yin/ /de phyir tshogs mchog mang 'dus khyams chen por/ /theg mchog zab mo'i sgo brgya rab dbye nas/ /thar 'dod thar pa'i go sar 'gran 'dod pa'i/ /chos spyod thar lam shing rta rab gsal bya/ /'di gang dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa dang dge ba'i rtsa ba chad pa med par tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtshor 'dren par mos pa rnams kyis ni/ lam bya sla la don chen po dang ldan pa chos spyod bcu'i sgrub pa la nyin mtshan kun tu ci nus kyis brtson par bya ba yin pas/ re zhig dang por de'i rim par bstan par bya ste/ gang zhe na/ thog ma kho nar rnyed ka'i dal 'byor gyis phan yon dang*/ 'jig sla ba'i tshul la yang yang bsam zhing las 'bras bslu ba med par yid ches bskyed de/ sdig spang dge sgrub kyi lag len mkhas pas rang gi ji ltar blangs pa'i bslab pa la nan tan snying por byed pa nyid gzhir byas ste/ rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ /gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug /ces gsungs pa ltar rjes su dran pa drug dang ldan pas dad pa bskyed pa dang*/ de'i grogs dge ba'i bya ba gang la'ang phyi bshol med par 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas skyo dub med par mthar skyel zhing*/

ngom tshad med par slob pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ tshe 'di dang 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung pa dang*/ thar lam gyi ngo bo dang phan yon yid la byed pa dang*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas 'khor ba'i sems can la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems drag po bskyed pa'i sgo nas/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig las/ tho rangs kyi dus la bab pa na/ gnyid rmugs dang le lo'i dbang du mi gtong bar dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran pas langs te/ rmi lam du sdig pa mthong na 'phral du bshags shing*/ dge na rjes su yi rang ba tsam byas la/ lus gnad drang por bsrang zhing*/ yid rnal du phab te/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas phyag mchod la sogs pa bya ba'am/ gal te man ngag thob na bsam gtan gyi ngang du ci nus mnyam par 'jog go /de nas snga gro yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byas te/ nyin mtshan kyi cha la yan lag cung zad nyams pa gso zhing ma nyams kyang spel bar bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed blangs la/ phyag dang mchod pa bya ba'am/ yang na/ gtor ma gtong ba/ mdo sde klog pa/ mchod rten la bskor ba sogs thun mtshams kyi bya ba ci 'grub zhig byas nas/ kha zas kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ phud dang lhag ma sogs gtong la kha zas la ma chags pa'i sgo nas longs spyod la mdo dang bsngo smon rnam par dag par gdon par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas klog pa'am/ chos nyan pa'am/ bsam gtan sgom pa sogs dge ba'i phyogs gang rung zhig byas la/ nyi ma phyi phred la bab pa na/ dub pa bsang ba'i phyir mig gnya' shing gang tsam du blta zhing sems ma 'khrul ba'i sgo nas cung zad 'chag pa dang chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis kyang dga' bar byas nas/ sāts+tsha gdab pa dang*/ gsung rab yi ge 'dri ba sogs thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ji ltar rigs pas brtson par bya zhing*/ dgong mo'i dus su phyag 'tshal sngon du 'gro bas/

'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin la/ smon lam gyi khyad par mang du gdab par bya'o/ /srod la bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog pa'am/ yang na gsung rab 'don pa'am/ de dag gi don la rnam par dag pa'i lung dang rigs pa la brten nas dpyod cing don la sems pa la nan tan du bya zhing*/ nam gung gi thun la bab pa na dge ba'i sems kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang*/ nyin bar gyi cha la snga dro dang*/ gung dang phyi dro gsum dang mtshan mo'i cha la'ang srod dang gung dang tho rangs gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa dang*/ sems bskyed yang nas yang du gso ba sogs bya'o/ /khyad par tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga dang gnam stong rnams la chos 'chad pa po yod na dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa dang ldan pas mtshan mo ril gyi chos nyan pa'am/ nam phyed la thug gi bar du dam pa'i chos la nyan bshad bya'o/ /de lta bu ma 'byor na sku gzugs dang mchod rten la sogs pa'i drung du phyag mchod dang smon lam rnam par dag pa mang du 'don par bya ba'am/ yang na chos spyod kyi rim pa gang yang rung bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /gal te gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la zhugs pa zhig yin na/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor las mi 'da' bas snang spyod thams cad dag pa rab 'byams su bsgyur ba'i sgo nas/ thun bzhir gsang sngags phyi nang gi gzhung lugs las 'byung ba ltar bzlas brjod dang*/ gsang sngags kyi don sgom zhing*/ gtso bo bla na med pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la nan tan du bya ba dang*/ khyad par theg pa kun gyi rtse mo rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag thob pa zhig na/ rang bzhin babs kyi bsam gtan la mnyam par 'jog cing*/ snga dgongs la sogs pa'i dus gnad dang bstun te thod brgal bsgom pa'i rim pa la nan tan du byed pa rnams ni lhag par bsgrub par bya'o/ /yang gnas skabs ji ltar ba/

yon bdag la sogs pa'i bsod nams spel ba'i slad du/ skyabs sems sngon du btang te/ phyag mchod bshags pa rgyas pa rnams dang*/ mdo 'don pa la sogs pa'i rim pa rnams bya ba'am/ yang na yan lag bdun pa bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ don zab mo yid la bsam zhing tshig ji lta ba bzhin rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas mdo dang gzungs kha ton du bya ba'am/ glegs bam bklag pa gang rung bya ste/ gang ltar yang mjug tu smon lam btab par bya ste/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /de ltar spyod pa'i rim pa nges par byas nas/ da ni de rnams kyi skabs gang dang gang du bab pa na nyams su blang byar gyur pa'i chos spyod kyi rim pa grags che ba 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bsdeb par bya ba las/ blo chos la bskul ba'i ched du thog ma kho nar 'di skad ces bya ste/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'/ /skyes bu don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la blta dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur 'gyogs 'gro/ /dus kyis nyen nas rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na/ /longs spyod 'dza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*/ /skyes bu dag ni gar gnas gar 'gro yang*/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*/ /sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams/ /mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po/ /'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor/ /dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin/ /srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar/ /'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de/ /srid las 'byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs/ /bum par bcug pa'i bung ba 'khor bar bzhin/ /zhes pa rnams ngag tu brjod pa'am ma brjod kyang rung ste/

don bsam mo/ ༈ /de nas chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgom pa'i rim pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /lan gsum brjod/ ༈ /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/

dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pas mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ ༈ /mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing 'di dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ ༈ /de nas rgyal ba 'khor bcas bsod nams kyi zhing du spyan 'dren pa ni/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas/ /nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs te/ /dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/

/dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skye mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ ༈ /de nas khrus gsol ba'i thog mar khrus khang bskyed cing snyan brnan pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der/ ༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas khrus bgyi'o/ ༈ /khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa mi mnga' yang*/ /sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs phyir/ /gtsang ma'i chab kyis khrus bgyi'o/ ༈ /sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas gos 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/

/sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*/ /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyu 'gyur ba'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyangs phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /dri med mtshanan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*/ /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ /bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ ༈ /de nas yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char ka'i pad+ma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ /lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa/ /bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī seng*/ /pad+ma kā ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga/ /so zur gnubs nyang gter ston rgya rtsa sogs/ /bka' gter bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan rang byang sems bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rnal 'byor che dang a nu a ti sogs/ /theg pa rim dgu'i chos tshul rgya mtsho yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag tshal lo/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang*/ /'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che/ /legs par gsung dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che/ /skyobs pa bla med dam chos rin po che/ /'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la= /gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe/ /sa chen 'di na gom pa bdun bor nas/

/nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsung*/ /de tshe mkhas pa khyod la= /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba/ /mgon po mchog gyur khyod la= /gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe/ /'dzam+bu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang zhing*/ /lha bu gzhon nu drug gis btud gyur pa/ /de tshe mchod 'os khyod la= /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ /gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la= /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis/ /mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la= /mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur mdzad cing*/ /kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas/ /mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar me mdzad sogs rgyal ba 'das pa dang*/ /byang chub chen po da ltar bzhugs pa dang*/ /byams pa la sogs slad nas 'byon pa yi/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la= /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la= /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang*/ /shākya thub pa gau taṃ lha yi lha/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la= /mthun pa'i dge tshogs smon lam rmad byung zhing*/ /spyad pa spyod tshe nam yang mched gyur la/ /bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la= /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med/ /chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub/ /rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la= /mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni/ /dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs/ /thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che la=

/kun bzang rigs lnga sems pa yab yum dang*/ /thub drug sgo ba khro rgyal yab yum bcu/ /gnas yul ma mo dbang phyug sgo skyong sogs/ /dam pa rigs brgya'i tshogs la= /yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang*/ /rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs/ /bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la= /'dus pa bde dgyes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ /gdan bzhi mā ya thod pa gshin rje'i gshed/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi/ /ye shes lha tshogs kun la= /gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po dang*/ /phyag rgya'i rigs 'byung la sogs sngags kyi lha/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las/ /gang gsungs rnams la gus pas= /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*/ skyes rabs rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la= /'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs/ /sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel/ /nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*/ /nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la= /rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas/ /bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa/ /rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la= /'gro ba'i mgon po shākya seng ge yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gang gi phyag tu bzhag /gsung rab rin chen sgrom gyi kha 'byed pa'i/ /dgra bcom gnas brtan rnams la= /shā ri'i bu dang mo'ud+gal gyi bu/ /kun dga' sgra can 'dzin dang ma 'gag pa/ /gang po rab 'byor 'od srungs nye 'khor sogs/ /nyan thos grangs las 'das la= rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs/

/dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang*/ /tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi/ /'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la= /bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang*/ /chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs/ /dbyen bzlum sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis rlabs/ /myang 'das mchod rten rnams la= /hūm̐ mdzad 'jam dpal bshes gnyen bi ma la/ /pra bha hasti dha na saṃ skri ta/ /nā gārdzu na gu h+ya tsan+d+ra dang*/ /shīn+ti gar+bha rnams la= /in+d+ra bhū ti bi ru sa ra ha/ /lo hi nag po pa dang dril bu pa/ /sangs rgyas gsang ba sgegs pa rdo rje sogs/ /dpag yas grub chen rnams la= /mgon po klu sgrub ār+ya de ba dang*/ /thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags/ /chos skyong yon shaka rnam gnyis dpa' bo sogs/ /'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la= /'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs/ /kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me sbar/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu/ /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la= /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos rigs brgya'i bdag /phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'khor los bsgyur ba po/ /snang srid dbang du sdud pa'i mthu stobs can/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la= /byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin cing*/ /gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus pa/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yi/ /khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs la= /nam snying sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal mchog dbyangs/ /mtsho rgyal 'brog mi dpal ye dpal seng ge/ /bai ro chos rgyal rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs/ /grub brnyes rig 'dzin rnams la= /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos la sogs pa/ /'gro ba'i don du tshul bzhin bsgyur dang spel/ /sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba cher mdzad pa'i/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog rnams la= /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi bstan pa'i srog /nges don lam bzang gsal mdzad so zur gnubs/ /nyang ral chos dbang kun mkhyen chos rje sogs/

/bka' gter bla ma rnams la= /'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /'dzin dang spel dang srung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams la= /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis/ /sgrub pa po la ma yis bu bzhin skyong*/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= /gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i/ /rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la= gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*/ /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ /gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams la= /tshangs pa rgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang ris mgon po ste/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la= /ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/

zhes pa nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ ces pa'i bar ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa mchod pa'i yan lag ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ /me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /sman gyi rnam pa gang zhig yod pa dang*/ /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*/ /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*/ /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*/ /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*/ /lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni/ /spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*/ /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dang*/ /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa/ /yongs su gzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nam mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyod kyi yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyid/ /sngon gyi sdig las yangs dag 'da' bgyid cing*/ /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yis/

/dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi/ /thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog man+dha ra dang pad+ma dang*/ /ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*/ /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi/ /lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi pad+mo tshar du dngar ba yi/ /rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der/ /me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bya/ /gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ /'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa sgreng ba yang*/ /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*/ /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /de nas/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar ro/

༈ /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi ā hūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe ā hūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam+bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /i daṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir yā ta yā mi/ ༈ /gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas/ da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/

mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags gyi dam tshigs dang 'gal ba dang*/ pha dang ma la ma gus pa dang*/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa dang*/ grogs tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa la sogs pa sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du btsal ba dang*/ gzhan gyis bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mi sbed do/ /phyin chad sdom par bgyid lags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /zhes sogs so/ ༈ /bzhi pa dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa yan lag phyi ma bzhi ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ zhes pa nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ ༈ /de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga ni/ /sbyor ba yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du song ba'i rjes su dngos gzhi ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang*/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes dang*/

byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du btang nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /de bzhin du ni bslab pala'ang*/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed blangs la/ mjug tu dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /long bas phyag dar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes/ zhes dang*/ bdag gi de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la 'gron du bos zin gyi/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa yang*/ /gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*/ /bdud kyi las rnams spang bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa/ /sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa/
/de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /dge'o//
